about: Graphs and the outline each one IS (36 §6.4): `expect.tree` is describeOutline's text, written by hand; `expect.refused` is the refusal's code and the step it names. The four demo workflows of the first consumer are transcribed with shortened settings; their lines are exact.

graphs.name: enrolment-health
graphs.about: Demo 1: three counts side by side; each count sends `empty` straight to the Merge (an empty arm that rejoins).

config.message: Enrolment health needs attention: ${vars.below} of ${vars.graded} graded enrolments are below the pass mark.
Enrolment health is within bounds: ${vars.below} of ${vars.graded}.

graphs.name: failing-grades
graphs.about: Demo 2: a loop whose body holds a condition that rejoins at `raise`.

assignments.value: Offer a resit: completed below the pass mark

config.message: Checked ${nodes.failing.rows} enrolments graded below 40: ${vars.raised} follow-ups raised.

graphs.name: close-applications
graphs.about: Demo 3: nested conditions inside a loop, every arm ending at the body's end.

graphs.name: withdrawn-still-enrolled
graphs.about: Demo 4: two count reads in a loop; their `empty` arms exit to the next row past a later body step.

rows.detail: Marked withdrawn, but ${nodes.enrolled.count} enrolment(s) are still attending

graphs.name: sync-applications
graphs.about: The Main mock's "Sync applications from the portal". Its Otherwise ends and its Then never meets it, so the arms meet nowhere and Then holds the rest of the flow — the mock draws At the same time and Finish after the block instead, which the lines cannot say (36 §6.3; raised with the outline's handover).

graphs.name: fresh-blocks
graphs.about: Each block as the step picker inserts it: a condition with both arms empty and connected straight to what follows, a loop with its body and Next unconnected, a parallel with its one empty branch.

graphs.name: empty-flow
graphs.about: Start alone.

graphs.name: branch-open-arm
graphs.about: A condition whose false port is unconnected: the arm stops, meets nothing, and Then holds the rest.

graphs.name: stop-inside-branch
graphs.about: An HTTP step inside Then whose failure ends the run: the condition still carries on where its arms meet.

graphs.name: branch-rejoins-what-follows-its-block
graphs.about: A condition inside Then whose own Then ends and whose Otherwise goes straight on to what follows the outer block: its arms meet nowhere, and the one that goes on rejoins where its Seq goes on.

graphs.name: nested-loops
graphs.about: A loop inside a loop's body; the inner one's Done goes on to the outer one's Next.

graphs.name: branch-in-a-branch-of-parallel
graphs.about: A condition inside a parallel's branch whose arms meet at the Merge.

graphs.name: arm-stops-before-the-step-after
graphs.about: An HTTP step whose error arm logs and stops: the arm is open, the step carries on.

graphs.name: data-line-kept
graphs.about: A line between two DATA ports is not part of the outline and is kept as it is.

graphs.name: refuse-no-start
graphs.about: No Start step.

graphs.name: refuse-two-starts
graphs.about: Two Start steps.

graphs.name: refuse-unknown-type
graphs.about: A type the catalogue does not have.

graphs.name: refuse-unreachable
graphs.about: A step nothing leads to.

graphs.name: refuse-shared-step
graphs.about: Two branches of a parallel step both reach one step that is not their Merge.

graphs.name: refuse-arm-into-what-follows
graphs.about: An error arm goes into a step that also follows the step after it.

graphs.name: refuse-jump-between-branches
graphs.about: Spike S-outline: a line jumping from one branch into another.

graphs.name: refuse-jump-out-of-arm
graphs.about: An error arm that goes on past the step after its own.

graphs.name: refuse-two-continuations
graphs.about: Two lines out of one single port.

graphs.name: refuse-parallel-unjoined
graphs.about: Branches closed by two different merges.

graphs.name: refuse-merge-unpaired
graphs.about: A merge closing a condition rather than a parallel.

graphs.name: refuse-loop-never-returns
graphs.about: A body that never reaches its Next.

graphs.name: refuse-loop-next-from-outside
graphs.about: A step after the loop goes on with its Next.

graphs.name: refuse-loop-body-leaks
graphs.about: A body step reaches what runs after the loop.

graphs.name: refuse-loop-reenters-in
graphs.about: A body step goes back into the loop's in port.

graphs.name: refuse-cycle
graphs.about: A line back that is not a loop's Next.

graphs.name: limit-parallel-branches-share-an-end
graphs.about: Two branches of a parallel step end at ONE End, with no Merge (9 of the first consumer's test graphs). A Parallel is closed by a Merge (36 §6.3).

graphs.name: limit-merge-after-a-condition
graphs.about: A Merge closing a Condition's arms inside a loop (4 of the first consumer's test graphs). A Merge closes a Parallel step only.

graphs.name: limit-error-arm-rejoins-after-the-success-path
graphs.about: A step's error arm rejoins after the step its success path runs (1 of the first consumer's test graphs). An ordinary step carries on by its continue port; its arms rejoin there.

graphs.name: parallel-whose-branches-all-end
graphs.about: A parallel with no Merge whose every branch ends on its own (a loop with nothing after Done; an End): nothing to wait for, no continuation.

graphs.name: refuse-unknown-port
graphs.about: A line from a port the type does not have.

graphs.name: refuse-broken-line
graphs.about: A line to a step that is not there.
